name: Haselünne (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of blue, white and blue with a broad white middle stripe, charged above the centre with the city arms of Haselünne (a saint above a shield on white).
history: Municipal flag of Haselünne; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
